title: Hide the Home relay-allowance banner
description: Home renders the relay allowance card from the shell notice (ft()?.notice on 0.36, et()?.notice on 0.38), not from RelayUsageStore, so 0001 leaves the 20-hour card visible. Make the notice lookup falsy so the limit card and its meter never render.
notes: If the lookup moves, run collect and search the index chunk for relayAllowance or dismissKey. The core still posts the native 'remote hours used. Pro allows' notification; that text lives in core_bg-*.wasm.
